item_8_contract.reason: T1 item 8 asks for one aggregated artifact of per-spec-row performance across conditions; this report covers device characterization only and lists programming yield, full sense margin and retention as unmeasured, and has no digital-partition (Fmax/area/power) content

measurement_notes: I_off is a gmin-floor-limited upper bound (gmin = 1e-13 S), set jointly by true device leakage and the numerical floor; it is not a resolved subthreshold current.
Capacitor leakage comes from the stock cap model, which has no DC branch; it is a model-structural value, not a measurement of oxide leakage.
R_on is the real part of the small-signal impedance at 10 MHz; it carries a single-digit-percent to ~10% capacitor-geometry sensitivity, so it is reported per sub-configuration.
At the sf process corner Candidate 3's fixed gate overdrive is not fully on (R_on in the MOhm range); those values are reported as measured, not filtered.
Sizing and geometry levels are the netlist defaults and a x2 width, not the ratified split-axis levels.
Values are pre-breakdown, stock-model results at rated-voltage validity; nothing here predicts silicon behavior from assumed model parameters.

policies.input_selection: Only records listed in inputs.json are consumed (no directory globbing). Each is pinned by sha256 of its record file, its netlist snapshot, and a digest over all raw logs under its corners/ directory. A pin mismatch means the committed evidence moved after selection: the record is excluded and disclosed as hash_mismatch.
policies.supersession: A selected record is stale if any committed record in the experiment's records/ directory names it in its 'Supersedes' field, or if its netlist snapshot no longer matches the current design netlist. Stale records are excluded and disclosed; the replacement must be selected explicitly by a new inputs.json (new bundle id). Newer same-region records that do not name the selected record are listed as informational 'unselected_same_region' notes, never silently preferred.

scope: This report covers antifuse cell DEVICE characterization only (access-device OFF-state leakage, ON-state series resistance, pre-breakdown capacitance and the stock-model leakage floor) for the selected candidate/region records. It does not cover the whole block: no array, addressing, program-path, sense-path or SPI evidence is summarized here.
